Step 6 of the human IT ticketing workflow: select an IT specialist and produce a complete handoff package.

## Layout

```text
skills/escalate-to-specialist/
├── SKILL.md
├── README.qmd
├── install.sh
└── scripts/
    └── escalate_to_specialist.py
```

## Install

```bash
bash skills/escalate-to-specialist/install.sh
```

## Usage through Claude

> "Escalate TKT-00042 to a specialist."

Claude reads `SKILL.md`, confirms the upstream signal authorizes an escalation, runs the script, and reports the chosen specialist + handoff.

## Direct CLI

```bash
uv run python skills/escalate-to-specialist/scripts/escalate_to_specialist.py --ticket-id TKT-00042
```

The script appends one row to `data/working/escalation_decisions.csv` and writes an action-log entry.

## Public functions

- `load_escalation_context(data_dir, out_dir, ticket_id)` — loads ticket, specialists, triage; resolves the escalation trigger from working FAQ / feedback rows.
- `select_specialist(context, specialists)` — group + system + seniority preference; tie-broken on `specialist_id`.
- `build_handoff(context, specialist)` — handoff summary, evidence list, specific question, missing-info flag.
- `build_escalation_row(context)` — the row written to `escalation_decisions.csv`.
- `write_escalation_decision(out_dir, decision)`.
- `main(argv)` — CLI. Exits 2 on missing data, 3 if no upstream signal authorizes escalation.

## Specialist selection

Tier order, first non-empty wins:

1. `specialist_group == triage.recommended_specialist_group` **and** `affected_system in systems_supported`.
2. `specialist_group == triage.recommended_specialist_group`.
3. `affected_system in systems_supported` (any group).
4. Any specialist.

Within the chosen tier we sort by seniority descending (`principal > senior > mid > junior`), tie-breaking on `specialist_id`.

## Refusal behavior

The script refuses to escalate when no upstream working row authorizes it (no FAQ check declined, no reopen recorded). It exits 3 with stderr explaining which prerequisite skill to run.

## Test

```bash
uv run pytest tests/skills/test_escalate_to_specialist.py -v
```
